pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who leads the meetings of the assembly of pupils? (1 mark)
   A. The gatekeeper
   B. The cook
   C. The driver
   D. The Speaker

2. What is mining? (1 mark)
   A. Taking minerals from the ground
   B. Catching fish
   C. Cutting hair
   D. Growing maize

3. Which place in Nairobi shows traditional homes and dances of many communities? (1 mark)
   A. Lamu Old Town
   B. Gede Ruins
   C. Bomas of Kenya
   D. Fort Jesus

4. What does respect mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring people
   B. Treating people and things with honour
   C. Insulting people
   D. Breaking things

5. What does a class representative do? (1 mark)
   A. Brings the ideas and complaints of classmates to the meeting
   B. Cooks food
   C. Teaches lessons
   D. Punishes pupils

6. On a dot map, what does a group of many dots close together show? (1 mark)
   A. An empty area
   B. A road
   C. A river
   D. A crowded area

7. Which season usually follows the long rains in Kenya's common pattern? (1 mark)
   A. Long rains again
   B. Cool or cold season
   C. Hot season
   D. Short rains

8. What is a museum? (1 mark)
   A. A place where crops are grown
   B. A bus stage
   C. A kind of factory
   D. A building where old objects are kept and shown

9. Which of these is a good digital citizen habit? (1 mark)
   A. Talking to strangers
   B. Sharing passwords
   C. Sending mean messages
   D. Asking an adult before going online

10. Where might you see a school motto? (1 mark)
   A. On the badge or gate
   B. In a river
   C. In the sky
   D. On a rain cloud

11. What does a compass needle point to? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. South
   C. The sun
   D. The nearest town

12. On a weather chart, which symbol usually means a sunny day? (1 mark)
   A. A cloud
   B. A wind arrow
   C. A sun
   D. A raindrop

13. Which of these economic activities is a service? (1 mark)
   A. Teaching
   B. A fish
   C. A stone
   D. A crop of maize

14. Who is closest to the people among county administrators? (1 mark)
   A. The village administrator
   B. The president
   C. The governor
   D. The speaker

15. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Using phones or computers to hurt or frighten someone
   B. Reading a book
   C. Playing a computer game
   D. Writing a letter

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give two examples of natural resources. (2 marks)

17. List the five items on the sample agenda for a Children's Government meeting. (5 marks)

18. Give three ways of conserving natural resources. (3 marks)

19. Explain the meaning of profit and show how to find it. (3 marks)

20. What is a compass used for? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — The Speaker
   The Speaker leads meetings.

2. A — Taking minerals from the ground
   Mining takes minerals such as soda ash or titanium from the earth.

3. C — Bomas of Kenya
   The Bomas of Kenya is a cultural centre in Nairobi.

4. B — Treating people and things with honour
   Respect is showing care and honour.

5. A — Brings the ideas and complaints of classmates to the meeting
   Class representatives speak for their classmates.

6. D — A crowded area
   Many dots show many people.

7. B — Cool or cold season
   In the usual pattern, June to August is cool or cold in many places.

8. D — A building where old objects are kept and shown
   Museums keep artefacts safely and show them to people.

9. D — Asking an adult before going online
   Asking permission keeps you safe.

10. A — On the badge or gate
   Mottos are often on badges and gates.

11. A — North
   A magnetic compass needle always turns to point north.

12. C — A sun
   A sun symbol shows sunny weather.

13. A — Teaching
   Teaching is work done to help others.

14. A — The village administrator
   Village administrators work closest to families.

15. A — Using phones or computers to hurt or frighten someone
   Cyberbullying is bullying online.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water and soil. Accept forests, minerals, wildlife or fish.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Opening, reading the last minutes, reports from cabinet members, suggestions from classes, and closing remarks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant trees, save water, and reduce waste by reusing and recycling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Profit is the money left after all costs are paid. Profit = income - costs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for formula, 1 mark for correct example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A compass is used to find direction. Its needle points to north.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding direction, 1 mark for the needle pointing north.
